[[Spawning Power]] | damagetype = [[Fire damage]] | icon = Envoy Staff }}[[Heleyne's Insight]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] obtained from opening a [[Zaishen Strongbox]]. It is wielded by [[Emissary Heleyne]]. [[Image:Heleyne's Insight render.jpg|thumb|Render of Heleyne's Insight]] == Stats == :[[Energy]] +15 :[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]]) :Fire damage: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Fast Casting]]) :Fire damage: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]]) :Fire damage: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]]) :Fire damage: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Spawning Power]]) :Energy +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%) :[[HCT|Halves casting time]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%) :Health +30 ==Skin== It uses the [[Envoy Staff]] skin. ==Replica== Except for the [[damage type]] (with the exception of the Divine Envoy Staff, which requires Divine Favor and deals fire damage), it is possible to create a replica of this staff with the same stats and visual appearance. Replicas will cause the damage type associated with the inherent [[attribute]] (per [[Envoy_Staff#Notes|the notes on the Envoy Staff page]]). Create a replica with the following: *[[Envoy Staff]] from [[Jessie Llam]] - the only modifiable staff with 10% HCT spells rather than the normal 20% [[HSR]]. *[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]] *Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]] *Perfect "[[Hale and Hearty]]" inscription ==Notes== *Except for Divine Favor staves, [[Staff#Damage types of other staves|non-randomly generated]] Fast Casting, Soul Reaping, Energy Storage, and Spawning Power staves do not usually deal fire damage. * Only three other staves have two inscriptions and are missing a HSR 20% mod: [[Brohn's Staff]], [[Gorrel's Staff]] and [[Villnar's Staff]].
